plan: Drive: from District of Squamish, about 175 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.47304, -124.6958, where the truck road ends (Ebm); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the Ebm stretch, 4.7 km one way. About 95 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
